summary: @ornikar/browserslist-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package presents itself as a browserslist configuration (a single string of browser targets in degraded-support.js) but declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` file. setup.mjs itself is hex-identifier obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string-map wrappers) and constructs the Bun download URL `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, then execFileSyncs the extracted `bun` binary with the local `math_init.js` path. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (string-array shuffle constructor `WV8StW`, hex numeric arrays, single-line minification, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with no relation to the declared browserslist-config purpose. Installing the package causes an alternate-runtime dropper to execute an opaque author-controlled payload on the installer machine outside Node's tooling visibility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
